answer.reason: The verses tell of Agrippa's visit to Festus, his hearing of Paul, and his remark to Paul; the summary gives only his judgment of Paul.

clauses.english: came to Caesarea to salute Festus, and asked to hear Paul himself
clauses.quote: I would also hear the man myself.

clauses.english: told Paul he almost persuaded him to be a Christian
clauses.quote: Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

doubts: The summary names Agrippa's judgment of Paul (ACT 26:32), so it is left out of the clauses.
The first clause joins the visit and the request to hear Paul because the request grows out of the visit; it could be cut to one of the two.
